blocks.zh: 10. Sterilization and Depyrogenation | 滅菌與去熱原
blocks.en: 10. Sterilization and Depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：滅菌方法選擇層次
blocks.en: Core Concept: Hierarchy of Sterilization Methods

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 (Terminal Sterilization)：在最終密封容器中完成滅菌。優先選擇，因為容器密封後滅菌，風險最低。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization: Sterilization carried out in the final sealed container. It is the preferred option because sterilizing after the container is sealed carries the lowest risk.

blocks.zh: 選擇邏輯（優先順序）：
blocks.en: Selection logic (in order of preference):

blocks.zh: 蒸汽（高壓滅菌）→ 首選（水性製劑）
blocks.en: Steam (autoclave) → first choice (aqueous preparations)

blocks.zh: 乾熱 → 熱穩定但不耐濕的製劑
blocks.en: Dry heat → preparations that are heat-stable but not moisture-tolerant

blocks.zh: 輻射 → 特殊情況
blocks.en: Radiation → special cases

blocks.zh: 過濾滅菌 → 只有在終端滅菌不可行時使用
blocks.en: Filtration sterilization → used only when terminal sterilization is not feasible

blocks.zh: 關鍵數字：滅菌標準
blocks.en: Key Numbers: Sterilization Standards

blocks.zh:
終端滅菌目標：PNSU = 10⁻⁶
（百萬分之一的非無菌單位概率）
= Sterility Assurance Level (SAL)

6小時規則：
非無菌成分的注射用 CSP 必須在
製備完成後 6 小時內完成滅菌

去熱原要求：
≥ 3-log 內毒素降低（用 ECV 驗證）
例：250° × 30 min（常見週期）
每年用 ECV 驗證有效性

過濾滅菌：
0.22 µm 或更小
Brevundimonas diminuta 保留率：≥ 10⁷ /cm²
每批次須進行 post-use 氣泡點測試
blocks.en:
Terminal sterilization target:
PNSU = 10⁻⁶
(probability of a non-sterile unit of one in a million)
= Sterility Assurance Level (SAL)

6-hour rule:
Injectable CSPs made with non-sterile components must be
sterilized within 6 hours of completing preparation

Depyrogenation requirement:
≥ 3-log endotoxin reduction (verified with ECV)
Example: 250° × 30 min (common cycle)
Verify effectiveness with ECV every year

Filtration sterilization:
0.22 µm or smaller
Brevundimonas diminuta retention: ≥ 10⁷ /cm²
Post-use bubble point test required for every batch

blocks.zh: 重點提示：PNSU 不適用過濾滅菌
blocks.en: Key Point: PNSU Does Not Apply to Filtration Sterilization

blocks.zh: PNSU 10⁻⁶ 是終端滅菌的概率保證指標，基於已知的初始微生物負荷（bioburden）計算。過濾滅菌的原理是物理截留而非殺滅，無法以同樣邏輯計算非無菌概率。
blocks.en: PNSU 10⁻⁶ is a probabilistic assurance measure for terminal sterilization, calculated from a known initial microbial load (bioburden). Filtration sterilization works by physical retention rather than killing, so the probability of a non-sterile unit cannot be calculated with the same logic.

blocks.zh: 因此，過濾滅菌後以無菌充填方式分裝的 CSP，其無菌保證是透過過濾效率驗證（Brevundimonas 測試）+ 整個無菌製程的控制，而非 PNSU 數值。
blocks.en: Therefore, for a CSP that is filter-sterilized and then aseptically filled, sterility assurance comes from filter efficiency validation (Brevundimonas challenge test) plus control of the entire aseptic process, not from a PNSU value.

blocks.zh: 比喻：終端滅菌 vs 過濾滅菌
blocks.en: Analogy: Terminal Sterilization vs Filtration Sterilization

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌就像「把食物完全密封後再放入高壓鍋蒸煮」——在最終密封狀態下完成消毒，之後不再有再污染機會。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization is like sealing food completely and then cooking it in a pressure cooker: disinfection is completed in the final sealed state, so there is no further opportunity for recontamination.

blocks.zh: 過濾滅菌則像「先用超細濾網過濾食物液體，再裝入容器」——濾網必須完整（氣泡點測試確認），裝填過程必須完全無菌（無菌充填）。後者對操作環境的要求更高。
blocks.en: Filtration sterilization is like first straining the liquid food through an ultra-fine filter and then putting it into containers: the filter must be intact (confirmed by the bubble point test), and the filling process must be completely aseptic (aseptic filling). The latter places higher demands on the operating environment.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某藥師要調配含有蛋白質成分的注射用製劑，蛋白質在 121°C 高壓蒸汽下會降解。應選用哪種滅菌方法？
blocks.en: A pharmacist is compounding an injectable preparation containing a protein that degrades under steam autoclaving at 121°C. Which sterilization method should be used?

blocks.zh: 過濾滅菌後的過濾器通過了 post-use 氣泡點測試。這意味著什麼？如果失敗呢？
blocks.en: The filter passed the post-use bubble point test after filtration sterilization. What does this mean? What if it fails?

blocks.zh: 去熱原週期的效力驗證使用哪種指示劑？需要多少對數降低才算有效？
blocks.en: What indicator is used to verify the effectiveness of a depyrogenation cycle? How many log reductions are needed for it to be considered effective?

blocks.zh: 11–13. Records, Release Inspections & Labeling | 紀錄、放行與標籤
blocks.en: 11–13. Records, Release Inspections & Labeling

blocks.zh: 核心概念：MFR vs CR — 配方書 vs 生產記錄
blocks.en: Core Concept: MFR vs CR — Formulation Master vs Production Record

blocks.zh: MFR (Master Formulation Record, 主配方記錄)：類似食譜——說明如何製作這個 CSP 的完整指令，適用於所有批次。一個配方只需一份 MFR。
blocks.en: MFR (Master Formulation Record): Like a recipe, it gives complete instructions on how to make this CSP and applies to all batches. One formulation needs only one MFR.

blocks.zh: CR (Compounding Record, 調配記錄)：每次實際調配的執行記錄，記載這次用的原料批號、數量、操作人員等。每批次都需要一份 CR。
blocks.en: CR (Compounding Record): The execution record of each actual compounding, documenting the ingredient lot numbers, quantities, operators and so on used this time. A CR is required for every batch.

blocks.zh: MFR 是「標準」；CR 是「這次按照標準的執行結果」。
blocks.en: The MFR is the "standard"; the CR is "the result of following that standard this time".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：滅菌測試的批量限制
blocks.en: Key Point: Batch Size Limit for Sterility Testing

blocks.zh: 需要滅菌測試的 CSP，最大批量限制為 250 件。這個限制有雙重目的：
blocks.en: The maximum batch size for a CSP that requires sterility testing is 250 units. This limit serves two purposes:

blocks.zh: 限制單批召回的影響範圍（若測試失敗，最多影響 250 人）
blocks.en: It limits the impact of a single-batch recall (if the test fails, at most 250 patients are affected)

blocks.zh: 確保採樣比例合理（小批量 1-39 件：10% 採樣；大批量 ≥40 件：依 ⟨71⟩ Table 3）
blocks.en: It keeps the sampling proportion reasonable (small batches of 1-39 units: 10% sampling; large batches of ≥40 units: per ⟨71⟩ Table 3)

blocks.zh: 滅菌測試採樣計算
blocks.en: Sterility Test Sampling Calculation

blocks.zh:
批量 1–39 件：
  採樣數 = 批量 × 10%，無條件進位至整數
  例：15件 → 15 × 10% = 1.5 → 2件採樣
  例：39件 → 39 × 10% = 3.9 → 4件採樣

批量 ≥40 件：
  依 USP <71> Table 3 規定採樣數

批量上限：最多 250 件
  超過 250 件 → 必須分批次處理
blocks.en:
Batch size 1–39 units:
  Number of samples = batch size × 10%, rounded up to a whole number
  Example: 15 units → 15 × 10% = 1.5 → 2 samples
  Example: 39 units → 39 × 10% = 3.9 → 4 samples

Batch size ≥40 units:
  Number of samples per USP <71> Table 3

Batch size limit: maximum 250 units
  More than 250 units → must be split into separate batches

blocks.zh: 比喻：CR 如同航班記錄
blocks.en: Analogy: The CR Is Like a Flight Record

blocks.zh: 每次飛行都有獨立的飛行記錄（黑盒子、機長日誌）：飛行員姓名、起飛/降落時間、氣象條件、設備狀態、任何異常事件。即使同一架飛機飛了一百次同樣航線，每次都有獨立記錄。
blocks.en: Every flight has its own flight record (black box, captain's log): pilot name, takeoff/landing times, weather conditions, equipment status and any abnormal events. Even if the same aircraft flies the same route a hundred times, each flight has its own record.

blocks.zh: CSP 的 CR 邏輯完全相同：每批次調配都有獨立的詳細記錄，包含所有可追溯信息。
blocks.en: The CR for a CSP follows exactly the same logic: every compounding batch has its own detailed record containing all traceability information.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：標籤設計的合規要點
blocks.en: Practical Application: Compliance Points for Label Design

blocks.zh: 若 CSP 將送出調配設施外（如醫院藥局送往病房或門診），標籤必須包含設施名稱和聯絡方式。這對 CDMO 將調配製劑送往客戶設施的情況尤其重要，是常見稽查項目。
blocks.en: If a CSP will be sent outside the compounding facility (for example, from a hospital pharmacy to a ward or outpatient clinic), the label must include the facility name and contact information. This is especially important when a CDMO ships compounded preparations to a customer's site, and it is a common audit item.

blocks.zh: 另一重點：標籤必須與 MFR（如有）和 CR 互相驗證一致。
blocks.en: Another key point: the label must be cross-checked for consistency against the MFR (if any) and the CR.

blocks.zh: MFR 在什麼情況下必須建立？僅為單一病患調配的無菌產品是否需要 MFR？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances must an MFR be established? Is an MFR required for a sterile product compounded for a single patient only?

blocks.zh: 一批 Category 2 CSP 共 25 件，需要進行滅菌測試。至少需要採樣幾件？
blocks.en: A batch of 25 Category 2 CSPs requires sterility testing. What is the minimum number of units to sample?

blocks.zh: CSP 標籤上的 BUD 是從什麼時間點計算的？和廠商產品的 Expiration Date 有何不同？
blocks.en: From what point in time is the BUD on a CSP label calculated? How does it differ from the Expiration Date of a manufacturer's product?

blocks.zh: 14. Establishing Beyond-Use Dates (BUDs) | 建立有效期限
blocks.en: 14. Establishing Beyond-Use Dates (BUDs)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：BUD 的五個決定因素
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five Determinants of BUD

blocks.zh: BUD 由五個因素共同決定，每一個都會縮短或延長可允許的使用期限：
blocks.en: The BUD is determined jointly by five factors, each of which can shorten or extend the permitted period of use:

blocks.zh: 製備環境（Category）：SCA vs Cleanroom Suite
blocks.en: Preparation environment (Category): SCA vs cleanroom suite

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法：終端滅菌 > 過濾滅菌（無菌充填）
blocks.en: Sterilization method: terminal sterilization > filtration sterilization (aseptic filling)

blocks.zh: 起始原料：全無菌 > 含非無菌成分
blocks.en: Starting components: all sterile > containing non-sterile components

blocks.zh: 滅菌測試：通過後可獲得更長 BUD
blocks.en: Sterility testing: passing it allows a longer BUD

blocks.zh: 儲存條件：冷凍 > 冷藏 > 室溫
blocks.en: Storage conditions: frozen > refrigerated > room temperature

blocks.zh: BUD 決策快速查閱
blocks.en: BUD Quick Reference

blocks.zh:
Category 1（最短）：
  室溫 ≤ 12h；冷藏 ≤ 24h

Category 2（依條件）：
  最短：無菌充填+非無菌原料+無ST+室溫 = 1天
  最長：終端滅菌+ST通過+冷凍 = 90天

Category 3（最長）：
  最短：無菌充填+ST通過+室溫 = 60天
  最長：終端滅菌+ST通過+冷凍 = 180天

  ★ Cat 3 還需要：
    穩定性數據（穩定性指示方法）
    每次調配均需ST + 內毒素測試
blocks.en:
Category 1 (shortest):
  Room temperature ≤ 12h; refrigerated ≤ 24h

Category 2 (depends on conditions):
  Shortest: aseptic filling + non-sterile components + no ST + room temperature = 1 day
  Longest: terminal sterilization + ST passed + frozen = 90 days

Category 3 (longest):
  Shortest: aseptic filling + ST passed + room temperature = 60 days
  Longest: terminal sterilization + ST passed + frozen = 180 days

  ★ Cat 3 also requires:
    Stability data (stability-indicating method)
    ST + endotoxin testing for every compounding

blocks.zh: 重點提示：BUD 不累加原則
blocks.en: Key Point: The Principle That BUDs Are Not Cumulative

blocks.zh: CSP 可能在不同溫度下依序儲存（例如：先冷凍，解凍後冷藏，最終室溫給藥）。但 BUD 不能累加！
blocks.en: A CSP may be stored sequentially at different temperatures (for example, frozen first, then refrigerated after thawing, and finally administered at room temperature). However, BUDs cannot be added together!

blocks.zh: 一旦 CSP 被置於需要較短 BUD 的儲存條件（如室溫），就必須在那個較短的時間內使用。例：Category 2 無菌充填+全無菌起始原料 CSP，冷凍45天後轉室溫，室溫 BUD 僅為 4 天（不是 45+10+4 天）。
blocks.en: Once a CSP is placed in a storage condition that carries a shorter BUD (such as room temperature), it must be used within that shorter period. Example: for a Category 2 CSP prepared by aseptic filling from all-sterile starting components, if it is frozen for 45 days and then moved to room temperature, the room temperature BUD is only 4 days (not 45+10+4 days).

blocks.zh: 比喻：BUD vs Expiration Date
blocks.en: Analogy: BUD vs Expiration Date

blocks.zh: 廠商效期（Expiration Date）就像原廠蘋果汁的保存期限——是在工廠密封、完整測試後標示的。
blocks.en: A manufacturer's Expiration Date is like the shelf life on factory-sealed apple juice: it is assigned after the product is sealed and fully tested at the factory.

blocks.zh: BUD 就像把蘋果汁開瓶後裝入另一個容器——從開始製備的那一刻起計算，因為原廠保護已不再完整，環境污染的風險從此時起開始累積。
blocks.en: A BUD is like pouring the apple juice into another container after opening it: it is counted from the moment preparation begins, because the manufacturer's protection is no longer intact and the risk of environmental contamination starts to accumulate from then on.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Category 3 的商業價值
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Commercial Value of Category 3

blocks.zh: Category 3 CSP 最長可達 180 天冷凍 BUD（終端滅菌+滅菌測試）。這使大批量調配和集中配送成為可能，大幅提升效率。
blocks.en: A Category 3 CSP can have a BUD of up to 180 days frozen (terminal sterilization + sterility testing). This makes large-batch compounding and centralized distribution possible and greatly improves efficiency.

blocks.zh: 然而代價是顯著的：每批次均需滅菌測試（約 14 天出結果）、需要穩定性數據支撐、每週環境監測等。必須計算每個 CSP 的全部成本後，才能判斷 Category 3 是否有商業意義。
blocks.en: However, the cost is significant: sterility testing for every batch (results take about 14 days), supporting stability data, weekly environmental monitoring and so on. The full cost of each CSP must be calculated before deciding whether Category 3 makes commercial sense.

blocks.zh: Category 2 CSP 以無菌充填法從全部無菌起始原料製備，冷藏儲存，未進行滅菌測試。最長 BUD 為何？
blocks.en: A Category 2 CSP is prepared by aseptic filling from all-sterile starting components, stored refrigerated, and not sterility tested. What is the maximum BUD?

blocks.zh: 同上，若改為終端滅菌且通過滅菌測試，冷藏 BUD 最長為何？
blocks.en: As above, but if terminal sterilization is used instead and the CSP passes sterility testing, what is the maximum refrigerated BUD?

blocks.zh: Category 3 CSP 需要哪種穩定性研究方法？為何一般的濃度測定法不夠？
blocks.en: What kind of stability study method is required for a Category 3 CSP? Why is an ordinary assay of concentration not sufficient?

blocks.zh: 多劑量 CSP 開封後，在 BUD 和 28 天之間，應遵守哪個限制？
blocks.en: After a multiple-dose CSP is opened, which limit applies, the BUD or 28 days, whichever is shorter?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 滅菌優先序：終端滅菌（蒸汽 > 乾熱 > 輻射）> 過濾滅菌；目標 PNSU 10⁻⁶
blocks.en: Sterilization priority: terminal sterilization (steam > dry heat > radiation) > filtration sterilization; target PNSU 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: 6小時規則：含非無菌成分的注射劑，製備完成後 6 小時內必須完成滅菌
blocks.en: 6-hour rule: injectables containing non-sterile components must be sterilized within 6 hours of completing preparation

blocks.zh: MFR：適用多批次或含非無菌成分的 CSP；CR：每批次均需建立
blocks.en: MFR: applies to CSPs made in multiple batches or containing non-sterile components; CR: required for every batch

blocks.zh: BUD 核心表格：Cat 1（≤12h/24h）；Cat 2 依方法/測試/儲存條件最長 90 天；Cat 3 最長 180 天（冷凍終端滅菌+ST）
blocks.en: Core BUD tables: Cat 1 (≤12h/24h); Cat 2 up to 90 days depending on method/testing/storage conditions; Cat 3 up to 180 days (frozen, terminal sterilization + ST)

blocks.zh: BUD 不累加：一旦儲存於較高溫度條件，需遵守該條件的較短 BUD
blocks.en: BUDs are not cumulative: once stored at a higher-temperature condition, the shorter BUD for that condition applies
